rows: Damage from a severe thunderstorm was reported by a trained spotter near Leakey. The storm had blown down several trees along FM337 just west of the town.
A resident reported penny size hail 8 miles west-northwest of Leakey which caused some minor tree damage.
An employee at Camp Eagle reported hail the size of nickels.
Hail was reported at Camp Eagle.
Several trees were reported blown over.
A thunderstorm produced quarter size hail at two locations near Camp Wood.
A thunderstorm produced severe size hail. The largest hail was 2.5 inches and the average size was 1.75 inches.

A thunderstorm produced hail ranging in size from one half inch up to one inch.
A thunderstorm produced one and three quarter inch hail. The hail dented a car, destroyed shrubs and fruit on trees.
A thunderstorm produced one and one half inch hail which destroyed a sky light in a house. The hail was four inches deep a few places.

A thunderstorm produced two inch hail which dented a car, broke windows, and damaged a roof near Leakey. There was also three quarter inch to two inch hail from Barksdale to other locations around Leakey.
